description: This file defines hooks for server startup and shutdown processes in the Kubernetes API server, including registration and execution of post-start and pre-shutdown hooks, as well as health checks for post-start hooks.

classes.name: postStartHookHealthz
classes.description: Implements health check for post-start hooks, indicating whether a post-start hook has finished execution.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the health check.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Performs the health check, returning an error if the post-start hook is not finished.
